rollups.text: Career transition timeline: On 2024-03-03, James Perez, a clinical psychologist with eight years of experience in North Ericshire, was pursuing a senior clinical psychologist role by 2024-06-30 and targeting a 20% salary increase. He planned resume work, applications, interview preparation, networking, and CBT training. He received a Senior Clinical Psychologist offer from North Ericshire General Hospital on 2024-03-24: $62,000 salary and 20 vacation days; by 2024-03-25 he had negotiated a $3,000 signing bonus and planned to request $63,000–$65,000 and flexibility. He interviewed with MedPsych Clinic on 2024-03-28 and 2024-04-04; MedPsych offered $68,000 on 2024-04-10. After negotiation dated 2024-04-11, its final offer was $69,500, 25 vacation days, partial remote work, and a $3,000 signing bonus. A contract lawyer reviewed the offer on 2024-04-13 and recommended acceptance with minor adjustments. By 2024-04-25, the finalized MedPsych package was $69,500, a $5,000 signing bonus, full remote work, 30 vacation days, health insurance covering 90% of eligible costs, and a $1,200 annual training budget; the role was due to start 2024-05-01. James declined the North Ericshire General Hospital offer, citing MedPsych’s higher pay, better benefits, flexibility, and shorter commute. Elapsed time from the initial recorded career-search goal to the planned start date: about 59 days.

Job-search applications timeline: By 2024-03-03, James Perez had submitted three tailored resumes and was tracking 10 applications with deadlines from 2024-03-15 through 2024-04-30. He considered a target of 15 applications by 2024-04-01 and later expanded his search to Istanbul on 2024-03-25. He reported five applications submitted between 2024-03-15 and 2024-03-23, and seven new applications submitted between 2024-03-31 and 2024-04-09; on 2024-04-10 he said he had applied to seven jobs, four in North Ericshire and three in Istanbul, and paused new applications until after 2024-04-15. On 2024-04-22 he said all pending applications were closed and that he had submitted 12 total since 2024-03-01. Elapsed time from the stated start of application tracking to closure: 52 days.

MedPsych Clinic contract review timeline: On 2024-04-10, James Perez was weighing MedPsych Clinic’s $68,000 base salary offer, partial remote work, and a separate $70,000 offer under negotiation. He planned to consult a contract lawyer by 2024-04-12, prioritizing compensation and benefits, contract duration and termination, restrictive covenants, confidentiality and intellectual property, work hours and location, and remote-work terms. On 2024-04-11, MedPsych made a final offer of $69,500, 25 vacation days, partial remote work, and a $3,000 signing bonus. On 2024-04-13, the lawyer reviewed the offer and recommended accepting it with minor adjustments. By 2024-04-25, James reported a finalized package of $69,500, a $5,000 signing bonus, full remote work, 30 vacation days, and health insurance covering 90% of eligible costs. Elapsed time from the initial documented contract-review plan to finalized package: about 15 days.

rollups.text: Advanced CBT training timeline: On 2024-03-03, James Perez planned to complete a CBT certification course by 2024-05-15 and considered a $1,200 course, but had not confirmed enrollment. By 2024-03-25 he was leaning toward an Advanced CBT course costing $900, scheduled to start 2024-04-05, to strengthen cognitive restructuring and exposure therapy skills. On 2024-04-10, he reported 40% completion and a 90% quiz average; by 2024-04-12, completion had reached 60% and the quiz average 93%. On 2024-04-25, he chose to use the MedPsych Clinic $1,200 annual training budget for a leadership workshop starting 2024-06-01 rather than a CBT refresher. Elapsed time from the initial course plan to the later training-budget choice: 53 days.

Professional interviews and preparation events: Sarah mock interview by Zoom scheduled for 2024-03-20 at 2:00 PM (T58); North Ericshire General Hospital 45-minute behavioral interview on 2024-03-22 (T218); MedPsych Clinic technical interview scheduled for 2024-03-28 at 2:00 PM, on Atatürk Avenue (T230, T254); MedPsych Clinic second-round interview on 2024-04-04 (T492). James practiced STAR behavioral answers and technical topics including generalized anxiety disorder, OCD, and bipolar disorder with substance abuse on 2024-03-25 (T220, T234).

Professional networking events and contacts: James met Sarah at the 2023 Istanbul Psychology Conference on 2023-11-12 (T30); met Matthew at the North Ericshire Community Center on 2024-02-20 (T40); attended a networking dinner with Karen at Deniz Restaurant on 2024-03-18 (T286); attended the Turkish Psychological Association conference on 2024-04-07 and made professional connections (T514); and scheduled monthly virtual industry-trend meetings with Nicolas beginning 2024-05-10 (T720). Matthew congratulated James on LinkedIn on 2024-04-24 and had mentioned contacts at Istanbul clinics; an introduction request was drafted on 2024-04-25, but sending was not confirmed (T738, T744, T746, T748).

Mindfulness, meditation, and anxiety-management practices: James reported 15-minute morning mindfulness meditation at 7:00 AM on 2024-03-25 (T248); on busy days he reduced sessions to 10 minutes by 2024-03-25 (T396). He used the Headspace app for guided meditation from 2024-04-05 through 2024-04-10 and reported a 25% reduction in anxiety (T610). He planned a 5-minute body scan after meditation, mindful walking at lunch, and brief breathing reminders (T250, T252).

Trips and celebrations: James booked a weekend getaway to Lake Sapanca for 2024-04-06–2024-04-07 as a reward for interview milestones (T398); Sharon booked a celebratory dinner at The Olive Tree for 2024-04-15 (T674); James and Sharon planned a Cappadocia trip for 2024-05-15–2024-05-17 to celebrate his new MedPsych Clinic job and relax before starting (T734, T742). James celebrated the MedPsych offer with Sharon at La Petite Bistro on 2024-04-10 (T538).

Job-search tools and professional resources used or considered: James planned to use Jobscan ATS optimization by 2024-03-10 (T38); updated his LinkedIn profile on 2024-03-01 and reported a 40% rise in profile views within five days (T172); used Trello to track applications and later had an “Offers & Negotiations” column (T420); began using Grammarly Premium on 2024-03-20 for cover letters and emails; and used Zoom for interviews, reporting on 2024-04-10 that he had used it for all job interviews and was impressed by its stability (T662).

James Perez reported submitting 12 total job applications between 2024-03-01 and 2024-04-22; on 2024-04-10 he reported seven applications submitted between 2024-03-31 and 2024-04-09, with four in North Ericshire and three in Istanbul. These are reported totals from separate records; the records do not establish that every intermediate application count refers to a distinct, non-overlapping set.

Reported confidence changes during James Perez’s job search: daily negotiation practice from 2024-03-23 through 2024-03-29 was associated with a self-rating increase from 50% to 75% (25 percentage points) (T392); on 2024-03-25 he separately said rehearsing salary scripts with Sharon improved confidence by 30% (T302, T312); after negotiation and a lawyer consultation, he reported confidence rising from about 50% to 85% (35 percentage points) (T610-related record). These are separate self-reports and should not be combined into one continuous measurement.

Job-search priorities changed over time: on 2024-03-03 James preferred clinical psychologist roles within 30 km of North Ericshire and wanted commutes under 45 minutes (T168, T174); on 2024-03-25 he expanded the search to Istanbul, 120 km away, to explore higher salary potential (T350). Later he prioritized remote flexibility to reduce a reported 60-minute daily commute (T574, T576, T580).

rollups.text: MedPsych Clinic role and advancement: On 2024-04-25, the user had chosen MedPsych Clinic over North Ericshire General Hospital and was preparing for the role, scheduled to begin 2024-05-01 at 09:00 (T798, T898, T900). The user started on 2024-05-01 and met 12 team members during the first week (T906). On 2024-06-20, the user interviewed for an internal promotion; by 2024-06-25, the user said they had been offered promotion to Lead Clinical Psychologist (T1344, T1376). The user later said they had started leading a 10-person clinical team on 2024-07-01; on 2024-07-20, they planned introductory one-on-ones, role clarification, SMART objectives, regular team meetings, and leading by example (T1492 not used; source record for team size has no ID). Elapsed time: 50 days from role start to promotion interview; 11 days from interview to reported offer; 6 days from offer report to leading the team.

Promotion interview preparation and portfolio: On 2024-05-20, the user had a presentation scheduled at MedPsych Clinic, later rescheduled to 2024-05-22 at 15:00 (T1108). On 2024-06-05, the user was preparing for an internal promotion interview scheduled for 2024-06-20 at 10:00 and was balancing preparation with clinical duties (T1128, T1130, T1238). From 2024-06-05 through 2024-06-19, the user scheduled daily preparation blocks from 19:00 to 20:30 (T1266). The user preferred structured mock interview practice and reported completing three mock interviews with Sarah between 2024-05-25 and 2024-06-04, with a reported 30% improvement in response clarity (source record has no ID). The interview took place on 2024-06-20 with five senior staff members (T1344). Elapsed time: 15 days from the start of scheduled daily preparation blocks to the interview.

Salary goals and negotiation: On 2024-05-10, the user discussed seeking a 10% raise after six months at MedPsych Clinic (T924). On 2024-06-05, in connection with an internal promotion, the user targeted a 15% increase from $69,500 to $79,925 (T1128). On 2024-06-25, the user asked about negotiating $80,000 for a Lead Clinical Psychologist role (source record has no ID), later described $82,000 as a compromise and wondered whether to have held out for more (T1410, T1416). The user prefers using clear, concrete data in salary negotiations (T1426). Separately, on 2024-07-15, the user discussed a potential $4,000 mid-year bonus with HR and, by 2024-07-20, was considering asking for $5,000 (source record has no ID). Elapsed time: 46 days from the first recorded raise discussion to the promotion-related salary target; 40 days from the promotion interview to the later $82,000 compromise discussion.

Work-home boundaries with Sharon: By 2024-04-25, the user had agreed to check work email only between 08:00 and 19:00 at Sharon's request and said they were glad to have set that boundary (T820). On 2024-05-15, the user again described the 08:00–19:00 email limit and separately said Sharon had asked them to avoid work calls after 20:00 (T918, T970). On 2024-06-05, the user said they and Sharon had agreed to discuss work at home only during designated times (T1242). On 2024-06-25, the user again said they were glad to avoid checking work email after 19:00 and asked about maintaining related boundaries (T1420). Elapsed time: 61 days from the first recorded email boundary to the latest reaffirmation.

Professional-development events and courses: Advanced CBT course—reported 60% complete on 2024-04-12 (source record has no ID), still 60% complete with a 92% quiz average on 2024-05-15 (T984), and reported completed with a 95% final score by 2024-06-05 (T1244). Istanbul Business School leadership workshop—registered by 2024-04-25 for 2024-06-01–2024-06-05, with a reported $1,500 fee (T786, T794, T790); a later 2024-04-25 record said the registration fee had risen to $1,700 after added modules, and the user was unsure about the investment (T892). Conflict-resolution workshop—reported enrolled on 2024-07-10–2024-07-12 for $600 (T1422); a separate discussion on 2024-06-25 concerned a possible discounted $500 virtual workshop on 2024-07-10–2024-07-11, with attendance not confirmed (T1540, T1542, T1547). These workshop fee and schedule reports differ and are retained as recorded.

Professional contacts and support: Sharon, the user's partner, supportive friend, and colleague, supported work-life boundaries and shared career and personal events, including a planned Cappadocia trip for 2024-05-15–2024-05-17 (T912), dinner at The Olive Tree on 2024-05-10 (T944), and the user's promotion celebration at Mikla Restaurant on 2024-06-24 (T1384). Cassandra shared contract-negotiation experience on 2024-04-23 (T810), gave the user a healthcare-leadership book on 2024-05-08 (T948), and sent congratulatory flowers on 2024-06-25 (T1386). Nicolas began monthly virtual meetings with the user about industry trends on 2024-05-10 (T922) and invited the user to a virtual roundtable on 2024-05-18 (T946). Stephanie provided leadership coaching on 2024-06-21, including conflict-resolution skills (T1388); the user had a coaching session scheduled with her for 2024-07-05 at 16:00 via Zoom (source record has no ID). Sarah conducted three mock interviews with the user between 2024-05-25 and 2024-06-04, according to the user (source record has no ID).

Stress-management and physical activities: The user reported practicing yoga twice weekly at North Ericshire Wellness Center from 2024-04-18 and associated it with a 20% reduction in stress (source record has no ID). The user planned a 10 km hike with Sharon at Belgrad Forest on 2024-05-18 (source record has no ID). The user started swimming at Istanbul Sports Club on 2024-06-02 (source record has no ID) and later described swimming and yoga as part of their stress-management strategy on 2024-06-25 (source record has no ID; T1476).

Job-search outcomes recorded on 2024-04-25: the user reported exactly five rejections and no response from three applications (T832, T844, T850). The user considered changing strategy and requesting feedback, and was advised to contact about three of the five rejecting companies (T840, T841, T852).

Promotion interview practice: the user reported completing three mock interviews with Sarah between 2024-05-25 and 2024-06-04 and a 30% improvement in response clarity (source record has no ID). The user later said they preferred structured interview preparation with mock sessions (source record has no ID).

Reported confidence values changed across several career conversations: 90% on 2024-04-25 after securing the user's preferred MedPsych Clinic salary and benefits (T802); 92% on 2024-05-15 after successful team integration and positive feedback (T1010); and 98% on 2024-06-25 following a reported successful negotiation and promotion (T1452). The measures were self-reported and their underlying scales were not specified.

MedPsych Clinic vacation-day figures changed across records: the initial role package was recorded as including 30 vacation days (source record has no ID); a promotion offer/package dated 2024-06-23 was later described as including 35 vacation days (source record has no ID), and on 2024-06-25 the user also referred to 35 vacation days in the offer (source record has no ID). The record does not resolve whether this reflects a changed package or a discrepancy.

The user reported completing the Advanced CBT course with a final score of 95% by 2024-06-05 (T1244). Earlier, the user reported a 93% quiz average on 2024-04-12 and a 92% quiz average on 2024-05-15 (source record has no ID; T984). These are different assessments and should not be read as a single score decreasing over time.

The user’s career-development path progressed from considering leadership versus clinical specialization on 2024-07-20, to choosing internal growth over external job searching on 2024-09-10. The user received a 12% raise to $92,000 annually effective 2024-09-01, completed a performance review on 2024-08-30, and negotiated a $3,000 annual training budget, reported on 2024-09-10. The user aims to prepare for director-level roles by 2028 and favors strategic planning. Elapsed time from the initial career-path discussion to the director-level goal: 52 days.
